title: Brief special meeting for closed labour session
subtitle: Council authorized an in-camera labour relations discussion; no delegations, disclosures or mayoral updates, and a quick adjournment.
overview: Kitchener City Council held a short special meeting on January 20, 2025, chaired by the Mayor. The meeting opened with a land acknowledgement. No councillor declared a pecuniary interest, there were no delegations, and the Mayor had no business or updates to report.

The only item of business was authorizing a closed (in-camera) meeting right after the special meeting to consider a labour relations matter. This is permitted under section 239(2)(d) of the Municipal Act, 2001. Council approved the authorization {{vote:m1}}.

For residents, the meeting made no public policy decisions. The minutes report no outcome from the closed session, so no further information is available. The meeting adjourned at 6:04 p.m., about four minutes after it began.

decisions.detail: Council agreed to hold a closed meeting immediately after the special meeting to consider a labour relations matter under section 239(2)(d) of the Municipal Act, 2001 {{vote:m1}}.

debate: No debate took place. The transcript shows the chair introducing the single item, a closed session on a labour relations matter, followed by a vote.
There were no delegations, and no councillors declared a pecuniary interest.
The chair noted that written comments received before the meeting would form part of the public record. The transcript does not mention any being received.
